Container.Name: agentloop
Container.Overview: AgentLoop runs Claude sessions on the items of an Overseer project tracker, one after another, with a web page to start and watch them. Set AGENTLOOP_TOKEN, which signs in to the page, and a Claude sign-in (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, from `claude setup-token`). To give a loop its repositories, use "Add another Path" once for each clone: a container path such as /code/orchard, and the host folder that holds it. Name that container path in the loop's places on the page. See docs/container.md in the repository.

Config.Name: Web page
Config.Description: The port of AgentLoop's page, which asks for AGENTLOOP_TOKEN.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Everything AgentLoop keeps: settings, logs, Claude logins, key files, each project's tools and the user's home folder.

Config.Name: Homebrew
Config.Description: Homebrew and every tool the projects' Brewfiles install, shared by all projects and kept across restarts and updates. Many small files: on a cache pool, /mnt/cache/appdata/agentloop-brew is faster.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user id the loops and their sessions run as; 99 is Unraid's nobody. Never 0. Give the id that owns your clones.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group id the loops and their sessions run as; 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: AGENTLOOP_TOKEN
Config.Description: The token that signs in to the page: 16 or more random characters, with no spaces, quotes, commas, semicolons or backslashes. Without one, a new token is printed in the log at each start.

Config.Name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
Config.Description: Claude's sign-in for every worker: the token that `claude setup-token` prints. Leave empty to log in inside the container instead.

Config.Name: EXTRA_PACKAGES
Config.Description: Debian packages a project needs beyond the image's, separated by spaces, installed at each start.

Config.Name: AGENTLOOP_BREW
Config.Description: 1: each project's tools come from the Brewfile in its first repository, installed with Homebrew into the Homebrew folder. Anything else turns that off.

Config.Name: GIT_USER_NAME
Config.Description: The name git puts on the loops' commits.

Config.Name: GIT_USER_EMAIL
Config.Description: The email git puts on the loops' commits.

Config.Name: GIT_TOKEN
Config.Description: A token for pulling and pushing HTTPS remotes, kept in the home folder where only the user can read it.

Config.Name: GIT_TOKEN_USER
Config.Description: The user name sent with GIT_TOKEN; x-access-token is what GitHub takes.
